name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Soften your knees and hinge forward with a flat back until your arms hang beneath your shoulders.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips to bring both dumbbells beside your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades briefly, then lower the dumbbells under control until your arms extend.
tips: Keep your neck aligned with your spine and maintain a steady torso angle.
Avoid rounding your lower back or jerking upright to finish the row.
